nextNote: Launching freezes the current question banks and approval routes into each assessment; editing them afterwards only affects the next launch and top-ups.
topUpNote: {{year}} has been launched: a top-up uses the current question banks and approval routes (the ones for the next launch).
title: Launch assessments
hint: Every active question bank × plant it applies to is listed. Only the combinations shown and checked are launched; launched ones are never issued twice.
empty: Nothing to launch (only audit admins see this list, or no question bank is active yet)
blocked: {{count}} checked combinations cannot be launched yet (no approval route, a route failing the launch check, or steps not assigned). Fix them or uncheck them to launch.
alreadyLaunched: {{year}} has {{count}} assessments launched (due {{due}}). You can add the combinations not launched yet; the due date stays.
yearFull: Every combination of {{year}} has been launched (due {{due}}); there is nothing left to add.
confirmBody: {{count}} assessments will be issued, due {{due}}. Launching freezes the question banks and approval routes, so later edits do not change the issued assessments. Each question bank is launched once a year for each plant.
confirmTopUpBody: {{count}} assessments will be issued, due {{due}} (kept from {{year}}). Launching freezes the question banks and approval routes, so later edits do not change the issued assessments. Each question bank is launched once a year for each plant.
done: Launched {{year}} with {{count}} assessments ({{scope}}), due {{due}}. Each step's signer is the one assigned on the approval route; every branch starts at once.
topUpDone: Added {{count}} assessments to {{year}} ({{scope}}), still due {{due}}. Each step's signer is the one assigned on the approval route; every branch starts at once.

refused.title: Not launched
refused.alreadyLaunched: These combinations were already launched in {{year}} (perhaps just now, by someone else): {{combos}}. The list has been refreshed; check it and launch again.
refused.stale: The list of combinations changed elsewhere. Reload the page, then launch again.
refused.missingRoute: These combinations cannot be launched yet: {{combos}}. The list has been refreshed; complete them or untick them, then launch again.
refused.departedSigners_one: Someone on the approval routes is no longer employed, so nothing was launched. Assign someone else first:
refused.departedSigners_other: {{count}} people on the approval routes are no longer employed, so nothing was launched. Assign someone else first:

forbidden: Only an audit admin can launch an annual cycle.
doneUnchecked: Launched {{year}} with {{count}} assessments ({{scope}}), due {{due}}. OMS could not be reached, so nobody on the routes was checked for having left; keep an eye on progress.
topUpDoneUnchecked: Added {{count}} assessments to {{year}} ({{scope}}), still due {{due}}. OMS could not be reached, so nobody on the routes was checked for having left; keep an eye on progress.
